summary: Additional concrete own-source review finding: numpy.loadtxt silently skips blank/comment rows, risking original graph/observation row-ID shifts on malformed input. I am fixing strict row rejection on A branch and will issue A-M1-0003 shortly. Please do not promote older A handoff while this owned fix is pending.

details.trigger: A blank or comment row in .nodes/.arcs/.track causes loadtxt to skip it instead of raising, so original physical row-based IDs/counts can silently shift. Supplied 90-trip files are valid, so existing numerical evidence should be unchanged.
details.fix: Validate every physical table row has expected column count and parse with comments disabled from the same buffered text. Reject malformed input explicitly; retain NaN/invalid-coordinate rows for existing observation masks.
details.verification: Add focused regression cases, rerun scientific suite and actual development checks from committed source; retain new immutable run evidence. No contract change needed.
details.coordination: Source fix belongs to A; I will commit and repin. Use a fresh integration attempt from your fixed B SHA and new A handoff per protocol.
